coordinate_convention.origin: bottom-left corner of the board in docs/official/Fall_Game_Table_Overhead.png
coordinate_convention.X: along the 96 in length, left -> right: X = (1.2192 - y_blender) / 0.0254
coordinate_convention.Y: across the 48 in width, bottom -> top: Y = (x_blender + 1.2192) / 0.0254
coordinate_convention.Z: height above the FRP surface: Z = (z_blender - 0.0213) / 0.0254

sources.not_used: data/glb_objects_raw.json: Object.bound_box AABBs are inflated for meshes rotated by non-90 degree angles (30 of 146 meshes differ by >0.02 in, up to 0.7 in)

board.surface_note: FRP 'bumpy side up' (PDF sheet 3): textured white surface

playing_interior.note: PVC inner edges; PDF sheet 8 gives 93.08 x 40.20 (checked)

pvc.nominal_pipe: 1 in SCH 40 (BOM calls it '1 inch ID'); OD 1.315 in nominal, CAD pipe bbox ~1.30 in

tape_note: Tape strips measure 1.875 in wide in the CAD (3M #3920 duct tape is 1-7/8 in), not 2 in; lengths 93.5 / 89.5 / 41.5 / 12 match the mesh names and PDF sheets 7-8.

zone1.name: Zone 1 (top-left)
zone1.note: bounded by left PVC inner edge, center tape left edge, upper tape top edge, top PVC inner edge

zone2.name: Zone 2 (top-right)
zone2.note: mirror of Zone 1 across the center tape

zone3.name: Zone 3 (middle-left, pom side)
zone3.note: between lower tape top edge and upper tape bottom edge; the 5 pom stacks sit on the upper tape (Z1/Z3 boundary)

zone4.name: Zone 4 (middle-right, duck side)
zone4.note: between lower tape top edge and upper tape bottom edge; the 5 small ducks sit on the upper tape (Z2/Z4 boundary)

zone5.name: Zone 5 / large Starting Box (lower-left)
zone5.note: L-shaped: rectangle minus the Bottle/Ring enclosure footprint on its left end. Doubles as the large Starting Box (rules p.3)

start_box_small.name: Small Starting Box
start_box_small.note: bounded by center tape right edge, short 12 in tape left edge, lower tape bottom edge and bottom PVC inner edge; matches the 21.125 x 11.25 stated in rules p.3 and PDF sheet 7

bottle_ring_enclosure.name: Bottle/Ring enclosure
bottle_ring_enclosure.interior_note: pocket between the left wall pipe (inner edge x=1.462), the 8 in pipe (inner edge x=4.038), the lower 2.5 in pipe (top edge y=4.837) and the upper 2.5 in pipe (edge y=12.913): 2.58 x 8.08 in, walls are 1.46 in tall floor-level PVC on all 4 sides
bottle_ring_enclosure.open_side: none: closed U of floor-level PVC; pieces enter over the 1.46 in walls (right side x~4.0-5.3 faces Zone 5)

raised_platform.flush_edges: right edge (x=96) and bottom edge (y=0) flush with the board edge
raised_platform.supports: 4 legs (2.5 in pipe, Z 1.5-4.0) at each corner of a 19 x 11 in rectangle on floor-level PVC, each topped by an elbow carrying a 9.5 in beam (Z 4.04-5.34) along Y at x~72.8 and x~91.8

notch.note: 1.625 x 1.625 in cut (PDF sheet 6). In the CAD it is at the RIGHT end of the skirt (x 94.375-96), clearing T-connector T_7 which passes through the skirt plane; the PDF sheet 6 flat pattern draws it at the left end (mirror). It is not a usable gap (it is at the far right wall).

open_side.side: left (-X), at x=72.0 facing the small Starting Box
open_side.gap_note: the 12 in black tape (x 70.125-72.0) lies between the Starting Box and the opening

closed_sides.+Y (toward table interior): 5.5 in corrugated skirt at y=12.5-12.687, Z 0-5.498 (full height; notch only at far right)
closed_sides.-Y (bottom edge): board edge at y=0; floor-level PVC wall (pipe top Z 1.46) - nothing above it but the table edge
closed_sides.+X (right edge): board edge at x=96; floor-level PVC wall (Z<=1.46) - nothing above it but the table edge

entrance.limiting_width_note: 9.25 in wide below Z=2.998; 7.5 in wide between the corner elbows for Z 2.998-4.036; blocked above Z=4.036 by the 9.5 in support beam

under_platform.free_floor_note: board surface not covered by pipes/fittings: x 72.0 to right-wall inner edge, y between the two floor-level fittings at the entrance; the 17.625 in floor pipes sit at y 0.162-1.462 and 11.039-12.336

floor_obstructions.what: 17.625 in floor pipe along the bottom edge
17.625 in floor pipe just inside the skirt (floor-level wall, 1.3 in wide)

botguy_strip.note: board surface beyond the top PVC wall (Y>41.66). Botguy and the Big Duck target sit here.

botguy.faces: -Y (toward the table interior); visor/eyes at y 42.46-42.96, Z 5.4-6.1
botguy.scores: 15 pts on top of Raised Platform (rules p.5-6)

big_duck.facing: -X (beak toward the Starting Box side); beak tip x=72.13 is 0.13 in from the platform edge
big_duck.note: two mirrored halves: Mirror3 (y 5.751-8.135) + Split Line2 (y 3.366-5.751)
big_duck.target: Botguy's start footprint (see botguy.base_footprint) for 15 pts

bottle_spec.note: estimated from radial slices of the mesh (data/glb_profiles.json): body OD 2.53 to Z~2.7, shoulder tapers to neck at Z~3.8, neck OD ~1.06 up to Z 4.95 with a flange of OD ~1.30 at Z~4.1. A ring (ID 1.414) comes to rest on the shoulder at Z~3.67; three rings stack to Z~4.75 (< 4.95 neck top).

ring_spec.note: from mesh radial profile; the raw bbox in glb_objects_raw.json (2.71 in) is inflated. ID 1.414 vs post OD 1.30 and neck flange OD ~1.30 leaves only ~0.06 in per side.
